emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Typed email addresses for this client. The legacy single `email` field mirrors the primary entry and stays in sync with it on save.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The channel kind this email address is used for.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the primary email address. Exactly one entry SHOULD be primary; the first entry is treated as primary when none is marked.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether this email address has been verified as reachable.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Typed phone numbers for this client. The legacy single `phone` field mirrors the primary entry and stays in sync with it on save.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The channel kind this phone number is used for.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the primary phone number. Exactly one entry SHOULD be primary; the first entry is treated as primary when none is marked.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether this phone number has been verified as reachable.

socialProfiles.title: Social profiles
socialProfiles.description: Social network profiles linked to this client, used for advocacy sharing and engagement tracking.

network.title: Network
network.description: The social network this profile belongs to.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: The account handle or username on the network (without the leading @).

url.title: Profile URL
url.description: The full URL to the profile on the network.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether this profile has been confirmed to belong to this client.

followedByUs.title: Followed by us
followedByUs.description: Whether Conduction's own account follows this profile.

followsUs.title: Follows us
followsUs.description: Whether this profile follows Conduction's own account.

preferredChannel.title: Preferred channel
preferredChannel.description: The channel this client prefers to be contacted through.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name for this client (e.g. "Europe/Amsterdam"), used to schedule sends at a sensible local time.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language code this client prefers for communication (e.g. "nl", "en").
